seoTitle: Connect WhatsApp to GoHighLevel: Setup Guide
metaDescription: Connect WhatsApp Business to GoHighLevel through the Marketplace, compare connector apps, and start managing WhatsApp conversations from your CRM.
intro: Unlike Facebook or Instagram, GoHighLevel doesn't have one built-in "Connect WhatsApp" button sitting in Marketing settings — WhatsApp gets wired up through the App Marketplace instead, using one of several third-party connector apps. That's not a flaw so much as a reflection of how fragmented WhatsApp Business access is across providers. This guide shows where to find those apps, what you're actually choosing between, and how to get conversations flowing into GoHighLevel once one is installed.

steps.heading: Start from your GoHighLevel dashboard
steps.body: Log into your sub-account and open the Launchpad, which lays out a checklist of foundational setup items — contacts, lead generation, communication channels — each with its own completion percentage. WhatsApp isn't part of this default checklist, but it's worth confirming your phone and email services are already configured here first, since some WhatsApp connector apps expect those pieces to be in place before they'll finish their own setup.

image.caption: The Launchpad's foundational setup checklist. WhatsApp isn't listed as a default item — it's added separately through the Marketplace.

steps.heading: Open the App Marketplace
steps.body: From the left sidebar, click Marketplace Apps, then search "WhatsApp" in the search bar at top right. Rather than a single official integration, you'll see a results page full of independent apps — GREEN-API WhatsApp, VoidFix WhatsApp, Wappfy, WhatsApp ChatBot, WhatsApp Connector, and more, each built by a different developer with its own install count, star rating, and pricing.

image.caption: Searching "WhatsApp" in the Marketplace Apps directory turns up more than fifty connector apps rather than a single native integration.

steps.heading: Understand what you're actually comparing
steps.body: These apps split roughly into two camps. Some connect through WhatsApp's official Cloud API via Meta, which means message templates need pre-approval and there are usage-based costs, but delivery is stable and sanctioned. Others promise "no Meta approval, no templates" by syncing an existing WhatsApp Business account more directly — faster to set up, but more exposed if WhatsApp changes how it treats third-party access. Read each app's description carefully before installing; the difference between them matters more than the star rating.

steps.heading: Install the app that fits your setup
steps.body: Once you've picked one, click into its listing and hit Install. You'll be walked through that app's own authorization flow — typically logging into WhatsApp Business, scanning a QR code, or entering API credentials from a WhatsApp Business Platform account, depending on which app you chose. This step lives entirely inside the third-party app's own flow, so what you see here will vary more than it does for a native integration like Facebook or Instagram.

steps.heading: Configure messaging preferences
steps.body: After authorization, most of these apps ask you to set basic preferences: which GoHighLevel sub-account the WhatsApp number is tied to, whether incoming messages create new contacts automatically, and how outbound messages get tagged. Take the time to get contact-creation right here — it's the setting most likely to either flood your CRM with duplicate contacts or silently drop a lead if it's misconfigured.

steps.heading: Send a test message to confirm the sync
steps.body: Message your connected WhatsApp Business number from a personal phone and check that it appears in GoHighLevel's Conversations tab within a minute or two. If nothing shows up, the most common culprits are an incomplete authorization step or a webhook that didn't save — most connector apps have a status indicator on their own settings page that will flag a broken connection before you find out the hard way.

steps.heading: Automate replies and follow-ups
steps.body: With WhatsApp messages landing in Conversations, build a workflow that triggers on a new WhatsApp contact or inbound message — an instant acknowledgment, a routing tag, or a scheduled follow-up sequence. Keep the automated reply short; WhatsApp is a more personal channel than email, and a message that reads like a form response tends to get ignored faster there than anywhere else.

faq.question: Does GoHighLevel have a native WhatsApp integration?
faq.answer: Not a single built-in one the way it does for Facebook or Instagram. WhatsApp is connected through the App Marketplace using a third-party connector app, and there are dozens to choose from.

faq.question: Which WhatsApp connector app should I pick?
faq.answer: It depends on whether you want the official WhatsApp Cloud API (more stable, requires message template approval) or a more direct sync that skips Meta approval but carries more risk if WhatsApp tightens access. Read each listing's description before installing.

faq.question: Can I automate responses to new WhatsApp leads?
faq.answer: Yes, once a connector app is installed and messages are flowing into Conversations, you can trigger GoHighLevel workflows off new WhatsApp contacts or messages just like any other channel.

faq.question: Why isn't my WhatsApp message showing up in GoHighLevel?
faq.answer: Usually an incomplete authorization step during the connector app's setup, or a webhook that didn't save correctly. Check the app's own settings page for a connection status indicator first.

faq.question: Is connecting WhatsApp free?
faq.answer: Some Marketplace connector apps are free to install with usage-based messaging costs, others charge a flat subscription. Pricing is shown on each app's listing before you install it.
